what: blaze-vfs's journal format moved to BZJ4 (crates/blaze-vfs/src/journal.rs): MAGIC is now *b"BZJ4", CHECKSUM_DOMAIN is "blaze v2 vfs journal record 2", and a FILE record's (kind 1) checksum is over its content ID, not its payload: `checksum(FILE, &ContentId::of(blaze_vfs::FILE_DOMAIN /* "blaze v2 vfs file 1" */, payload).0)`, i.e. `Hasher::new(CHECKSUM_DOMAIN).update(&[1]).update(&id.0).finish()` first 8 bytes. Other kinds are unchanged (`update(&[kind]).update(payload)`). Edits: vfs_journal_records.rs:47-48 the two consts; its `frame()` gets `let sum = if kind == 1 { checksum(1, &ContentId::of("blaze v2 vfs file 1", payload).0) } else { checksum(kind, payload) };`; the dictionaries in vfs_journal_records.rs:37, vfs_journal_bytes.rs:29 and vfs_journal_model.rs:34 say b"BZJ4". Seed corpora holding BZJ3 records now read as torn at their first record; regenerate any whose point was a whole record (e.g. vfs_journal_bytes, vfs_journal_records/*.hex).

history.note: vfs_journal_records.rs: MAGIC BZJ4, CHECKSUM_DOMAIN record 2, frame() sums a FILE record over ContentId::of(FILE_DOMAIN, payload); dictionaries of records/bytes/model say BZJ4; corpus vfs_journal_bytes/{magic-after-magic,magic-with-a-length-past-the-end,empty-record-with-a-bad-checksum}.hex rewritten to BZJ4. vfs_journal_records corpus is descriptions framed at check time, unchanged.
